mode.about.acro: No self-levelling: the drone holds its attitude
mode.about.angle: Self-levelling: let go of the sticks and it levels out
mode.about.horizon: Levels near centre stick, flips at full stick
mode.chip.title: Flight mode
mode.radioDecides: Your radio's switch {src} sets the mode
mode.switch.title: Mode switch
mode.switch.listen: Flip the switch you use for flight modes
mode.switch.none: None: you pick the mode in the simulator (M)
set.flight.mode.help: Angle levels the drone when you let go of the sticks; Horizon levels it too but flips at full stick; Acro holds the attitude, like a freestyle quad. M or the mode chip switches it; a mode switch set on your radio's check screen decides instead.
set.input.stickMode.help: Which stick is the throttle in the calibration drawings: Mode 2 on the left, Mode 1 on the right.
set.level.strength.help: How firmly angle mode levels the drone and follows the stick: higher is snappier. Betaflight's angle strength (angle_p_gain, 50 by default): at 100 the drone reaches half the stick's tilt in about 70 ms instead of 100.
set.level.angleLimitDeg.help: How far the drone tilts in angle mode at full stick: more tilt, more speed. Betaflight's angle_limit (60° by default).
set.level.horizonStrength.help: How firmly horizon mode levels the drone near the stick centre: higher levels harder. Betaflight's horizon level strength (75 by default).
